manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: Mardu Siegebreaker must be exiled by Wormfang Drake, and Changeling Berserker must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Berserker for its mana cost.
When Changeling Berserker enters, it exiles Wormfang Drake until Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Berserker's ETB.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles Changeling Berserker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When Changeling Berserker leaves the battlefield, Wormfang Drake is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Wormfang Drake's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Berserker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
